svg.aria-label: Plowed Street box assembly steps and lock
svg.text: Plowed Street box: assembly and lock
Part outlines match the cut sheets. Keep the plate, the shelf and the drawer free of glue where they slide. Not cutting templates.

g.text: Glue P, K, L, R to B (finger joints).
Leave the lid off. P is the front, with
the drawer opening; T goes on last.
Drop F into the wall slots (no glue yet).
PL rests loose on F: never glue it.
The channel in PL faces the front.
Glue two STEM discs on each dot on PL,
one on top of the other. Put a CAP on
each, but only after the lid is on (step 6).
Glue the five panels. DK, the one with the
tab on top, goes at the back, tab up.
Glue the two RAILs on the base under the sides.
Slide the drawer in. The tab must pass through
F's slot and stand inside PL's bay.
Pull it out and in; it should move freely.
Set T on, with both stems in their streets.
Glue CAPs on the stems above T. Then glue T.
Slide the plow to HOME, then to LaVale Mall.
The way to LaVale Mall (the lid's streets, to scale)
Under the lid: the plate over the drawer's lug
Red: the lug (the drawer's tab). Plow at HOME (left): the lip stops it.
Plow at LAVALE MALL (right): the channel is over it. The drawer opens.

svg.text: Streets 17 segments, 9 mm apart, 6 mm wide; the two maps are identical (42 mm apart) so the plate cannot turn.
